description: Test suite for verifying the configuration loading and validation logic of the Discord-related parts of the application. It uses Vitest for testing various aspects such as configuration structure, data coercion, and validation of Discord IDs.

methods.name: beforeEach
methods.description: Sets up the environment before each test by storing the current HOME environment variable.

methods.name: afterEach
methods.description: Restores the HOME environment variable after each test.

methods.name: the test case "loads discord guild map + dm group settings"
methods.description: Verifies that the configuration loads correctly with expected values.

methods.name: the test case "coerces safe-integer numeric discord allowlist entries to strings"
methods.description: Checks whether numeric IDs are correctly coerced into strings in the configuration.

methods.name: the test case "rejects numeric discord IDs that are not valid non-negative safe integers"
methods.description: Ensures invalid numeric IDs (negative, floating point, or too large) are rejected by validation.
